pr_title: txn: Optimize pessimistic transaction by supporting locking with conflict
pr_body:
<!--

Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and 
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: Close #40537

Problem Summary: 

### What is changed and how it works?

Requires https://github.com/tikv/client-go/pull/651. 

This PR optimizes pessimistic transaction by supporting pessimistic-locking with conflict and key-grained locking and waiting in TiKV. A system variable controlling the optimization is introduced.

### Check List

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- [x] Unit test
- [x] Integration test
- [x] Manual test (add detailed scripts or steps below)
- [ ] No code

Side effects

- [x] Performance regression: Consumes more CPU
- [x] Performance regression: Consumes more Memory
- [ ] Breaking backward compatibility

Documentation

- [x] Affects user behaviors
- [ ] Contains syntax changes
- [x] Contains variable changes
- [ ] Contains experimental features
- [ ] Changes MySQL compatibility

### Release note

<!-- compatibility change, improvement, bugfix, and new feature need a release note -->

Please refer to [Release Notes Language Style Guide](https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/release-notes-style-guide.html) to write a quality release note.

```release-note
Support aggressive locking model for pessimistic transaction, which can reduce tail latency of point-get DMLs in pessimistic transactions that have frequent lock contention. It can be enabled by the system variable `tidb_pessimistic_txn_aggressive_locking`.
```

issue_context.title: Support aggressive-locking model for pessimistic transaction
issue_context.body:
This is a corresponding issue of: https://github.com/tikv/tikv/issues/13298

Make use of the aggressive locking model provided in client-go and TiKV. Support enabling it with a system variable.

- Design (TiDB part): https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/37518
- PR: https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/35588
